evidence_snippets: The display you see in the Alert Overview tab depends on a variety of factors: If no playbook is attached to the alert, the default display is defined by the administrator in SOAR Settings .
Explore the alert overview tab Supported in: Google secops SOAR This document serves as a reference for the Alert Overview tab, the central interface for triaging alerts within a case.
If several playbooks are attached to an alert, and have customized views, you can select a different view from the Alert View menu.

evidence_snippets: The case queue—automatically refreshed every minute—lists all active cases and lets you manually refresh, sort, filter, add, or close cases as needed.
They collect enrichment data, analyst comments, and historical context, letting analysts track entity behavior over time and across cases.
Playbook automation Playbooks are predefined sets of actions that collect information from internal and external alert sources.
